data.name: Bhatu
data.gender_notes: Bhatu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhatu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Bhagat, meaning 'devotee' or 'servant of God'. The name Bhatu is often used to refer to the Hindu god Ganesha, who is considered the lord of wealth and the remover of obstacles. This name is believed to bring prosperity and abundance to those who bear it. The name Bhatu carries the meaning “Lord of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhatu usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies devotion and service to the divine.
data.etymology: Bhatu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhatu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

This name connotes a strong character and unwavering dedication to one's beliefs.
